description: GB dispatch model, published by Open Energy Transition, provides a maintained PyPSA-Eur-derived Great Britain dispatch modelling workflow. Coverage: The documented software is configured for the chosen system; the reviewed pages establish no fixed geographic coverage, spatial resolution or time horizon. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): MIT (code); input data keep their own licences. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: The repository deliberately omits intermediate results and regenerates them from source data. Reproduction requires the workflow dependencies and raw input access. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support capacity planning, resilience studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: model-pypsa-eur is the upstream model; this maintained fork supplies a particular Great Britain dispatch workflow, not an alias of the full European model.
